# Perfect Home Renovation

> Licensed and insured home renovation contractor serving Metro Detroit, Michigan. Kitchens, bathrooms, basements, full-home renovations, flooring & tile, and roofing, with in-house crews, free on-site estimates, and permits pulled on every applicable job. Call 313-502-4555.

## Services

- [Bathroom Remodeling](https://www.perfecthomereno.com/services/bathroom-remodeling): Curbless showers, custom tile, heated floors, plumbing reconfigurations
- [Kitchen Remodeling](https://www.perfecthomereno.com/services/kitchen-remodeling): Open layouts, wall removal, custom cabinetry, stone surfaces
- [Basement Finishing](https://www.perfecthomereno.com/services/basement-finishing): Guest suites, theaters, gyms, income-ready units with egress and moisture control
- [Full Home Renovations](https://www.perfecthomereno.com/services/full-home-renovations): Whole-house modernization of layout, systems, and finishes
- [Flooring & Tile](https://www.perfecthomereno.com/services/flooring-tile): Hardwood, large-format tile, heated floors
- [Roofing](https://www.perfecthomereno.com/services/roofing): Full replacement and repair, flashing and ventilation done to spec

## Service Area

Metro Detroit, Michigan, including Detroit, Boston-Edison, Ferndale, Royal Oak, Birmingham, Pleasant Ridge, Troy, Grosse Pointe, and Huntington Woods.
